_comment: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX -- security response headers for the static site
_why: The static site is served by GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare. GitHub Pages ignores _headers, so the live pages carry only HSTS: no X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors (clickjacking), X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. /api/* already gets these from the Worker (SECURITY_HEADERS in workers/intel-gateway/src/index.js) and is excluded here.
_apply: Cloudflare dashboard -> Rules -> Transform Rules -> Modify Response Header -> create this one rule. For API automation, GET and back up the existing http_response_headers_transform entrypoint first; append or update only this rule, preserving every unrelated rule and order. Never PUT this single-rule document over an existing entrypoint. Requires Zone Transform Rules Edit. Verify response headers on live pages after applying.
_csp_note: Only frame-ancestors is set in the header CSP. Browsers enforce every CSP they receive, so a header policy containing only frame-ancestors restricts nothing else, and the pages' existing <meta> CSPs keep governing scripts/styles/connect.

rules.description: Security headers on static pages (not /api, /reports, /taxii, /auth -- the Worker sets its own)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "intel.cyberdudebivash.com") and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/api" "/reports" "/taxii" "/auth"}) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/reports/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/taxii/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/")

Permissions-Policy.value: geolocation=(), camera=(), microphone=(), usb=(), accelerometer=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=()
